activities.name: Until_Step1
activities.description:
Will check if the Job - Step 1 is completed or not
If Completed - Send Mail
or Wait 15 mins

source.sqlReaderQuery:
DECLARE @JobName NVARCHAR(100) = 'P4W HANA - Cost and Variance Analysis Reports';
DECLARE @StepID INT = 1;
-- Get latest running or recently finished job
;WITH LatestActivity AS (
   SELECT TOP 1
       ja.job_id,
       ja.start_execution_date,
       ja.stop_execution_date,
       ja.last_executed_step_id
   FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity ja
   INNER JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON j.job_id = ja.job_id
   WHERE j.name = @JobName
   ORDER BY ja.start_execution_date DESC
),
StepHistoryFiltered AS (
   SELECT
       h.job_id,
       h.step_id,
       h.run_status,
       h.run_date,
       h.run_time,
       h.message,
       CONVERT(DATETIME,
           STUFF(STUFF(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), h.run_date), 7, 0, '-'), 5, 0, '-') + ' ' +
           STUFF(STUFF(RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), h.run_time), 6), 5, 0, ':'), 3, 0, ':'), 120
       ) AS run_datetime
   FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h
   INNER JOIN LatestActivity ja ON h.job_id = ja.job_id
   WHERE h.step_id = @StepID
     AND CONVERT(DATETIME,
           STUFF(STUFF(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), h.run_date), 7, 0, '-'), 5, 0, '-') + ' ' +
           STUFF(STUFF(RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), h.run_time), 6), 5, 0, ':'), 3, 0, ':'), 120
       ) >= ja.start_execution_date
)
SELECT
   j.name AS JobName,
   s.step_id,
   s.step_name,
   h.run_status,
   h.run_date,
   h.run_time,
   h.message,
   ja.start_execution_date,
   ja.stop_execution_date,
   CASE
       WHEN h.run_status = 1 THEN 'Succeeded'
       WHEN h.run_status = 0 THEN 'Failed'
       WHEN ja.stop_execution_date IS NULL AND h.run_status IS NULL THEN 'In Progress'
       ELSE 'Unknown'
   END AS StepStatus
FROM
   msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
INNER JOIN
   msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps s ON j.job_id = s.job_id AND s.step_id = @StepID
LEFT JOIN
   LatestActivity ja ON j.job_id = ja.job_id
LEFT JOIN
   StepHistoryFiltered h ON j.job_id = h.job_id AND h.step_id = s.step_id
WHERE
   j.name = @JobName;

DECLARE @StatusMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
DECLARE @JobName NVARCHAR(100) = 'P4W HANA - Cost and Variance Analysis Reports';
DECLARE @StepID INT = 1;

;WITH LatestActivity AS (
   SELECT TOP 1
       ja.job_id,
       ja.start_execution_date,
       ja.stop_execution_date,
       ja.last_executed_step_id
   FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity ja
   INNER JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs j ON j.job_id = ja.job_id
   WHERE j.name = @JobName
   ORDER BY ja.start_execution_date DESC
),
StepHistoryFiltered AS (
   SELECT TOP 1
       h.job_id,
       h.step_id,
       h.run_status,
       h.run_date,
       h.run_time,
       h.message,
       CONVERT(DATETIME,
           STUFF(STUFF(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), h.run_date), 7, 0, '-'), 5, 0, '-') + ' ' +
           STUFF(STUFF(RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), h.run_time), 6), 5, 0, ':'), 3, 0, ':'), 120
       ) AS run_datetime
   FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory h
   INNER JOIN LatestActivity ja ON h.job_id = ja.job_id
   WHERE h.step_id = @StepID
     AND CONVERT(DATETIME,
           STUFF(STUFF(CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), h.run_date), 7, 0, '-'), 5, 0, '-') + ' ' +
           STUFF(STUFF(RIGHT('000000' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(6), h.run_time), 6), 5, 0, ':'), 3, 0, ':'), 120
       ) >= ja.start_execution_date
)
SELECT @StatusMessage =
   j.name + ' : Step ' + CAST(s.step_id AS VARCHAR(10)) + ' : ' +
   CASE
       WHEN h.run_status = 1 THEN 'Succeeded'
       WHEN h.run_status = 0 THEN 'Failed'
       WHEN ja.stop_execution_date IS NULL AND h.run_status IS NULL THEN 'In Progress'
       ELSE 'Unknown'
   END
   + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) +
   ISNULL(h.message, 'No message found') 
FROM
   msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
INNER JOIN
   msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps s ON j.job_id = s.job_id AND s.step_id = @StepID
LEFT JOIN
   LatestActivity ja ON j.job_id = ja.job_id
LEFT JOIN
   StepHistoryFiltered h ON j.job_id = h.job_id AND h.step_id = s.step_id
WHERE
   j.name = @JobName;


SELECT @StatusMessage AS FinalMessage

 -- Send the email
EXEC msdb.dbo.sp_send_dbmail
    @profile_name = 'Day3ActivityMail',
    @recipients = 'DL_MS_Reporting@carestream.com',
    @subject = 'P4W HANA - Cost and Variance Analysis Reports Job Step 1 Status',
    @body = @StatusMessage;

activities.name: Check_Job_Status
activities.description: Check if the job P4W HANA - Cost and Variance Analysis Reports is running or not running

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs j
            JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobactivity a ON j.job_id = a.job_id
            WHERE j.name = 'YourJobNameHere'
            AND a.stop_execution_date IS NULL  -- Job is running
            AND a.start_execution_date IS NOT NULL
        )
        THEN 'Running'
        ELSE 'NotRunning'
      END AS JobStatus;
